papers.title: Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Argues that agentic on-policy distillation fails because token-level teacher scoring is myopic and does not penalize safe but delaying moves, a mismatch called the rollout-scorer gap. Proposes R2S, which repairs the teacher using reward-free takeover rollouts from high-disagreement states before distillation. It beats three recent agentic distillation methods in all twelve configurations, by 12.8 success points on average over the strongest baseline.

papers.title: Representational Control over Self-Report & Behavior Coherence in LLM Risk-Taking
papers.summary: Uses activation steering with nine vector-extraction methods across four open-weight LLMs to test whether self-reported and enacted risk-taking share internal representations. Trait-based directions shift self-report but not behavior, and choice-based directions shift behavior but not self-report. Only task-specific directives affect both, and only weakly, so representational checks should complement behavioral evaluation.
